messages.subject: WC-00106 Hale - advice note for review
messages.plaintextBody:
Sarah,

Draft advice note attached. Headline: unfair dismissal defensible if the reorg is well documented, but the age discrimination point is finely balanced because of the "fresh generation of leadership" remark, which could shift the burden of proof. I've suggested opening at £100k ex gratia with authority to £115k, on top of the PILON and holiday.

Grateful for any comments before I send the client version.

Best regards,
